openai.reasoning: Respondent commits to pressing red and argues (incorrectly) that red is the individually safest choice because blue would kill red-pressers when blue is the majority; they also discuss scenarios about others’ button choices and end by still treating blue as only conditionally rational, not switching away from red.

gemini.reasoning: The respondent correctly identifies the dilemma as a coordination problem but makes a fundamental rule error by claiming that if the majority presses red, blue-pressers die (which is true) but also implying that red-pressers might die if the majority presses blue (which is false, as red-pressers survive regardless of the majority). Because they believe red-pressers can die when blue wins, they fail to identify red as the strictly dominant strategy.
